name: list-php-parts
description: List the PHP test parts (core, modules, packages) affected by the current change, as a matrix ready for per-part test jobs.

LIST_BASE_REF.description: Base branch/ref to diff against. Defaults to `GITHUB_BASE_REF`, which GitHub Actions sets automatically on `pull_request` events.

LIST_ALL.description: Select every part regardless of the diff [true,false].

matrix.description: JSON array of affected parts, each `{name,suite,path}`. Use with `fromJson`.

has-parts.description: true if at least one part has tests to run, false otherwise.
